query: 供应商反腐败管理 供应商反腐败管理 衡量企业在供应链环节识别、预防及处置腐败行为的制度化水平。重点考察廉洁协议的法律约束力、针对供应商的背景尽调（Due Diligence）、定期廉洁审计及违规退出机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：合同中包含严厉的反腐败与反贿赂条款（含关联交易穿透）；建立了针对供应商实益拥有人的背景尽调机制；定期开展针对高风险采购环节的专项廉洁审计；具备明确的“黑名单”库及永久终止合作的退出机制。 • 1分（合格）：要求供应商签署标准的廉洁协议或诚信承诺书，具备基础的入驻资质审核，对违规行为有处罚说明，但缺乏深度的背景尽调、主动审计或系统化的退出流程。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关供应商反腐政策披露，或仅有笼统的“商业道德”表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：反腐败条款签署及尽调机制覆盖 >80% 的活跃供应商（或重点业务领域供应商），且定期进行反腐败宣导培训。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅核心/大额采购供应商执行，或未说明具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 供应商反腐败 反贿赂条款 廉洁协议 诚信承诺书 供应商尽调 实益拥有人 关联关系申报 利益冲突声明 回扣 廉洁审计 供应商黑名单 因腐败终止合作 反腐败培训 第三方风险管理 supplier anti-corruption anti-bribery clauses integrity agreement supplier due diligence beneficial ownership related-party declaration conflict of interest declaration kickback integrity audit supplier blacklist termination for corruption supplier anti-corruption training third-party risk management 合同是否含反腐败/反贿赂条款及关联交易穿透？ 是否要求供应商申报与员工的亲属、利益或关联关系？ 是否对实益拥有人做背景尽调？ 是否对高风险采购做专项廉洁审计？ 黑名单与退出机制如何运作？ 签署与尽调覆盖多少活跃供应商？ 是否定期开展供应商反腐败宣导培训？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '供应商反腐败管理'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 合同是否含反腐败/反贿赂条款及关联交易穿透？ 是否要求供应商申报与员工的亲属、利益或关联关系？ 是否对实益拥有人做背景尽调？ 是否对高风险采购做专项廉洁审计？ 黑名单与退出机制如何运作？ 签署与尽调覆盖多少活跃供应商？ 是否定期开展供应商反腐败宣导培训？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有员工反贿赂政策；仅有笼统商业道德；仅有供应商环境审核；仅有行为准则中一笔带过的“禁止行贿”而无尽调退出；区分：供应商反腐败管理聚焦供应链第三方腐败预防与退出；企业反贿赂管理体系更广含员工与商业伙伴；行为准则是综合文本；道德采购还可能包含冲突矿产等人权采购议题。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: 供應商遴選制度 / Supplier Selection System
results.text: The Group has strict requirements on suppliers and supply chain management. We have developed and implemented supply chain management systems, and require employees and the management team to follow. This is to ensure that all potential suppliers can compete fairly and enjoy equal opportunities. When selecting a new supplier, the Group would review the supplier's business license and qualification according to the process, and would select at least three potential suppliers for quotation; after that, relevant departments within the Group such as the Procurement Department and the Engineering Department would assess the product quality, production scale, supply capacity and other basic information as well as testing the trial products of the suppliers based on the technology, design and quality requirements in order to ensure the stability of the supply chain.

results.section: GREEN OPERATIONS / 綠色營運
results.text: In the procurement process, the Group attaches great importance to the negative environmental impact of products and the environmental performance of our suppliers. Therefore, we are committed to implementing a green procurement strategy and offering the priority for considering the application of suppliers with ISO 14001 certification. The Group clearly sets out its requirements in the contracts. Suppliers must undertake and ensure that their production, sales, transportation and after-sales activities are in compliance with national environmental and occupational health and safety management requirements. Supplier assessment and project review are conducted on a semi-annual basis to review suppliers' commitment to environmental protection and their employment of environmentally friendly equipment and measures. Meanwhile, we strengthen our communication with suppliers and actively convey the Group's advocacy and support for green procurement.

GREEN OPERATIONS / 綠色營運

[Content]
In the procurement process, the Group attaches great importance to the negative environmental impact of products and the environmental performance of our suppliers. Therefore, we are committed to implementing a green procurement strategy and offering the priority for considering the application of suppliers with ISO 14001 certification. The Group clearly sets out its requirements in the contracts. Suppliers must undertake and ensure that their production, sales, transportation and after-sales activities are in compliance with national environmental and occupational health and safety management requirements. Supplier assessment and project review are conducted on a semi-annual basis to review suppliers' commitment to environmental protection and their employment of environmentally friendly equipment and measures. Meanwhile, we strengthen our communication with suppliers and actively convey the Group's advocacy and support for green procurement.

All directors and employees, whether full-time or parttime, contract or temporary staff, must become familiar and comply with the Code. During the year, the Group provided a training relating to the anti-corruption for the executive directors and all employees, to help them keep abreast of current trends and issues facing the Group. The Group also requires all business units to carry out compliance training for all employees at least once a year to enhance employees' awareness.
